PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

අƯ ɪෙශෂ
No. 1943/9 – WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 02, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: DST/LND/1/ACQ/76.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

Lot No. 150, 151 and 152 (Lots 03) allotments in total extent of about 0.0273 Hectare of lands name of Polkoratuwa and Ambalagewatta, Achariyawatte Kumbura alias Achariyawatta Kebella of land in Final Village Plan No. 313 and dated 04.09.2015 prepared by the Surveyor-Superintendent on behalf of Surveyor-General situated in the Village of Polommaruwa the Gramaniladhari Divisions Polommaruwa North and Polommaruwa South in the Minor Division of Giruwa Pattuwa-Western of Divisional Secretary’s Division of Tangalle in Hambantota District in the Southern Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot No. 150 — Name of the land: Polkoratuwa and Ambalagewatta; Extent of Land: 0.0151 Hectare Boundary: North: Lot No. 64 1/4 and 64; East: Lot No. 64 1/4 and 64; South: Lot No. 64 and 43; West: Lot No. 64 and 63.

02. Lot No. 151 — Name of the land: Achariyawatte Kumbura alias Achariyawatta Kebella; Extent of Land: 0.0099 Hectare Boundary: North: Lot No. 64; East: Lot No. 64 and 152; South: Lot No. 152 and 64; West: Lot No. 64 and 64.

03. Lot No. 152 — Name of the land: Achariyawatte Kumbura; Extent of Land: 0.0023 Hectare Boundary: North: Lot No. 151 and 64; East: Lot No. 64; South: Lot No. 64; West: Lot No. 64 and 151. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Office of Tangalle on 13th day of January, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 30th day of December, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
N. W. YAPA, Divisional Secretary, Divisional Secretariat, Tangalle.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Tangalle, 26th November, 2015. 12 - 521
